description.en: RoLEX  is a Romanian lexicon in which for each entry there is information about its lemma, part of speech, phonetic transcription, syllabification and lexical stress.

sparql.title: RoLEX SPARQL endpoint
sparql.description: SPARQL endpoint for RoLEX hosted at RACAI. A query form is available at https://relate.racai.ro/datasets/dataset.html?tab=query&ds=/rolex
